latin: Nec habens gratiam potest, etiam de potentia dei absoluta, deo non esse acceptus ad uitam aeternam, nec non habens esse acceptus.
translation: Not even by God's absolute power can one who possesses grace fail to be accepted by God to eternal life, nor can one who lacks it be so accepted.
